entries.title: UDL Quick Start: Multiple Means of Representation
entries.summary: A ~15-minute primer on the UDL principle of Multiple Means of Representation, with a knowledge check and a classroom-application reflection.

entries.title: UDL Quick Start: Multiple Means of Engagement
entries.summary: A ~15-minute primer on the engagement principle of Universal Design for Learning: recruiting interest, sustaining effort, and supporting self-regulation, with a knowledge check and a classroom action step.

entries.title: UDL Quick Start: Multiple Means of Action & Expression
entries.summary: A ~15-minute primer on the action and expression principle of Universal Design for Learning: physical access, multiple ways to show knowledge, and executive-function supports, with a knowledge check and an action step.

entries.title: Retrieval Practice: Quizzing that Builds Memory
entries.summary: A ~12-minute primer on retrieval practice (the 'testing effect') — why recalling beats re-reading — with a knowledge check and a classroom action plan.

entries.title: Giving Actionable Feedback to Students
entries.summary: A ~12-minute module on specific, actionable feedback — read the principles, then practice rewriting feedback in a scenario with formative AI coaching.

entries.title: Academic Vocabulary that Sticks
entries.summary: A ~12-minute primer on explicit vocabulary instruction — choosing high-value words, student-friendly definitions, and multiple encounters — with an embedded example word bank, a knowledge check, and an action step.

entries.title: Hard Conversations with Families: Live Practice
entries.summary: A ~20-minute practice module on difficult family conversations: a short primer on what works, then a live role-play with an AI-played parent to rehearse it, and a reflection. The role-play is formative practice and never graded.

entries.title: De-escalation in the Moment: A Branching Scenario
entries.summary: A ~15-minute primer on the escalation cycle and adult de-escalation moves, followed by a branching classroom scenario you walk one decision at a time, and a reflection.

paths.title: Evidence-Based Teaching Essentials
paths.summary: Three short modules on practices with strong evidence behind them: retrieval practice, actionable feedback, and multiple means of representation.

paths.title: UDL Foundations
paths.summary: The three principles of Universal Design for Learning, one short module each: representation, engagement, and action & expression.

paths.title: Responsive Communication
paths.summary: Feedback students can act on, family conversations you can practice live, and de-escalation you can walk one decision at a time.
